## PR checklist

- [ ] Scope described
- [ ] Updated notebook paths and filenames
- [ ] New notebook outputs were cleared (execution counts and outputs empty)
- [ ] Added/updated Colab links
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/validate_notebooks.py`
- [ ] Confirmed notebook execution results and recorded any skipped notebooks
- [ ] Checked data redistribution rights
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, API keys, or secrets were added
- [ ] Confirmed license notice and repository usage restrictions
- [ ] Reviewed for publication metadata and did not invent final DOI/ISBN/edition details
